description: Two modes: (1) commit-range mode — pass base_branch and head_branch to get the list of commits unique to head_branch (set difference base..head), optionally filtered by author/message/path; (2) content-diff mode — pass from_commit and to_commit to compute file-level unified diffs between two specific commits.

author.description: Commit-range mode: filter by author name or email (substring match)

base_branch.description: Commit-range mode: base side of the range (excluded). Defaults to the repository's default branch when head_branch is set.

from_commit.description: Content-diff mode: commit to diff from: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io).

head_branch.description: Commit-range mode: head side of the range (included). When set, switches to commit-range mode.

limit.description: Commit-range mode: maximum commits to return (1-1000, default 100)

message_filter.description: Commit-range mode: filter commits whose message matches this string (case-insensitive substring; passed to git log --grep)

path.description: Limit results to a specific file path

repository.description: Repository name, e.g. pgbouncer. Defaults to postgres when omitted. Aliases: repo, repo_name.

to_commit.description: Content-diff mode: commit to diff to: a SHA (>= 7 hex), branch, tag, major version (17, 9.6), <ref>~N, or a commit_id from another tool, or a commit URL (gitweb, git.postgresql.org, GitHub, pg.ddx.io). Default HEAD.

name: git_diff
